[MabiMoba] Consideration on whether to save Mystic Dice
There is often a debate in the community about whether to save higher-tier Mystic Dice or open them immediately.
I have considered which approach is more rational.
Note that while I have been opening them in order of size on a daily basis, I have not been hoarding them across multiple days.
Basically, it is thought that "saving them if you are not struggling with your current combat power" will lead to faster growth in the long run.
This is because saving them increases the number of dice available for improving your stats.

However, if you are missing out on rewards due to a lack of combat power, or if you are in an environment where you can obtain a large number of high-tier dice, it may be more advantageous to open them first.
